The Lighthill Report & DARPA Retrenchment

Academic Skepticism and The Onset of the First AI Winter

Sir James Lighthill reports to the British Science Research Council that AI research failed to achieve grandiose promises, leading to sweeping budget cancellations in the UK and US.

Sir James Lighthill argued that algorithms which performed well in laboratory "toy worlds" collapsed in real-world settings, where the search space grew exponentially and the computation became unaffordable. Soon afterwards DARPA sharply cut funding for basic AI research without a clear military application, and the first AI winter spread worldwide.
